plan: Given my private value is $28, I aim to balance winning and maximizing profit. I'll bid slightly above the midpoint to ensure a win while maintaining profit. The worst-case scenario is bidding too high, reducing profit. Bidding $15 should outbid cautious competitors while keeping potential profit high if I win. This bid ensures a good chance of winning without overpaying.

To maximize profit, I'll bid slightly above the average expected bid of competitors. My value is $16, so I'll aim to bid around $14. This ensures a profit margin if I win, given the worst-case scenario where the second-highest bid is just below mine. Bidding too high reduces my profit, while bidding too low risks losing the auction. With no history, I'll assume competitors bid near their values.

Given my value of $19, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while outbidding others. The worst-case scenario is bidding my value and winning with zero profit if I pay $19. To ensure a margin, I will bid $18.9, maximizing the chance of winning with a small profit risk. This strategy balances profit potential and risk of overbidding.
